title: kbask remediate answers an alert with a fixed remedy without a model session
goal: kbask.py remediate answers an alert of a kind whose remedy is fixed (an orphan process) through coord from a rule table with no model session; an alert of any other kind still starts the capped session

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, subprocess, tempfile, time
T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); B = os.path.join(T, 'bin'); os.makedirs(B); log = os.path.join(T, 'claude.log')
sh = os.path.join(B, 'claude'); open(sh, 'w').write('#!/bin/sh\necho "$@" >> ' + log + '\necho {}\n'); os.chmod(sh, 0o755)
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('KB_COORD')}
env.update(PATH=B + os.pathsep + env['PATH'], KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, 'c.sqlite'), CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=T, NO_COLOR='1')
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kbask.py', 'remediate', 'planted.unknown-kind'], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=180)
for _ in range(20):
    if os.path.exists(log): break
    time.sleep(1)
print('unknown kind:', p.returncode, os.path.exists(log))
assert os.path.exists(log), 'an alert of a kind with no fixed remedy did not start the capped session'
